title: Life cycle of a butterfly
examples: What is the first thing a butterfly starts as?
What does the caterpillar do before it becomes a butterfly?
How long does the chrysalis stage last?

explain.say: Look at this picture. A butterfly starts life as a tiny egg on a leaf.
Now look. This is the life cycle of a butterfly in 3D. Can you see the eggs and the caterpillar? Tap any part to hear about it.
The egg hatches into a caterpillar. At this stage, the caterpillar eats and grows.
When the caterpillar is big enough, it makes a chrysalis. It rests inside this hard case.
Then the chrysalis opens. A butterfly comes out and dries its wings.
The caterpillar changes completely inside the chrysalis. This big change is called metamorphosis.

faq.q: Does the caterpillar eat all the time?
faq.a: Yes, the caterpillar eats almost constantly to get energy for growing. It needs many leaves to get big enough.
Yes. The caterpillar is changing into a butterfly inside it.

faq.q: How long does the whole cycle take?
faq.a: The time can change depending on the weather and the species. Some parts take much longer than others.

faq.q: Where does a butterfly lay its eggs?
faq.a: Usually on the kind of plant its caterpillars like to eat.

faq.q: What is the difference between a chrysalis and a cocoon?
faq.a: A chrysalis is the hard case of a butterfly. A cocoon is usually spun by moths and is made of silk.

facts: Metamorphosis means a big change in life.
The caterpillar's main job is to eat and grow.
The chrysalis protects the change happening inside.

quiz.say: The caterpillar has eaten and grown big. What does it make next?
quiz.why: A big caterpillar makes a chrysalis. Inside it, the caterpillar changes.

wrong.1: The egg came first, before the caterpillar.
wrong.2: The butterfly comes later, out of the chrysalis.

quiz.say: A new butterfly comes out. What does it come out of?
quiz.why: The butterfly grows inside the chrysalis. Then it climbs out.

wrong.0: A caterpillar hatches from an egg, and the butterfly comes later.
wrong.1: Butterflies drink from flowers, but they come out of a chrysalis.

quiz.say: Which order shows the butterfly's life cycle?
quiz.why: Egg, then caterpillar, then chrysalis, then butterfly.

wrong.0: The caterpillar comes before the chrysalis.
wrong.2: The egg comes first, then the caterpillar hatches.
